name: BanchoLeomon
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Leomon] in name or w/[CS] trait: Cost 3
main_effect:
When this card would be played, if your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your other Digimon may digivolve into a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Leomon] in its name or the [CS] trait in the hand without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) Then, that Digimon may attack.
alt_effect: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Leomon] in name or w/[CS] trait: Cost 3
